en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Musa Bin Bakr, from Zurara who said,

‘I heard Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> saying that Al-Waleed Bin Uqba, when he was witnessed with the drinking of the wine, Usman said to Ali<sup>asws</sup>, ‘Judge between him and those who are alleging that he as drunk the wine.
so he was whiped by a whip which had two stripes, forty lashes’.
